{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Prosperity Line''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://hopegas.com/news/hope-gas-announces-250m-infrastructure-investment|title=hopegas.com|website=hopegas.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://marcellusdrilling.com/2026/03/hope-gas-announces-30-mile-m-u-pipeline-to-wv-data-center-campus/|title=marcellusdrilling.com|website=marcellusdrilling.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from West Virginia to northern Mason County, West Virginia.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://hopegas.com/news/hope-gas-announces-250m-infrastructure-investment|title=hopegas.com|website=hopegas.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://marcellusdrilling.com/2026/03/hope-gas-announces-30-mile-m-u-pipeline-to-wv-data-center-campus/|title=marcellusdrilling.com|website=marcellusdrilling.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
